newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecom to co-develop local loops.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecom to co-develop local loops.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Tuesday it will work with E/O Networks to develop digital local loops for their mutual customers.

The partners said the effort will allow telecommunications services providers to take advantage of high-bit-rate digital subscriber line (HDSL) technology. HDSL will mean faster and more economical deployment of T1 access lines and increased capability to move remote terminals closer to customer sites, the companies said.
ADC provides transmission and networking systems to deliver voice, data and video services.
Its shares closed off 1-1/8 Tuesday at 28-5/8.
